import numpy as np, os
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # full monochrome rows and columns mark separators
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    # separators are the full rows/cols with the most frequent separator color; here all are such
    rseps=set(sr); cseps=set(sc)
    rstarts=[0]+[r+1 for r in sr]; rends=sr+[h]
    cstarts=[0]+[c+1 for c in sc]; cends=sc+[w]
    tiles=[]
    for ra,rb in zip(rstarts,rends):
        if ra>=rb: continue
        row=[]
        for ca,cb in zip(cstarts,cends):
            if ca>=cb: continue
            row.append([grid[r][c] for r in range(ra,rb) for c in range(ca,cb)])
        tiles.append(row)
    # infer background as most frequent value among tile cells
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for tr in tiles for tile in tr for x in tile)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(x!=bg for x in tile)>=2 else bg for tile in tr] for tr in tiles]
